name: Kemo Kano ~My Strange Girlfriend~
source:
As a recent high school graduate, you decide to take a summer job to earn a little money before college begins.
 
When you find a job as a cottage caretaker, it seems perfect. It will last for the entire summer, it pays well, and the work seems easy enough…
 
Oh, and three beautiful girls also live there!
 
Not only are you going to be living with three girls, but these three have a special secret…
translation:
高中刚毕业的你决定找一份暑期工作，在大学开学前赚点钱。

当你找到一份小屋管理员的工作时，一切似乎完美。工作持续整个夏天，薪水不错，任务也很简单……

哦，而且那里还住着三名漂亮女孩！

你不只是要和三个女孩同住，她们还隐藏着一个特殊秘密……
